name: apple-overseer-cskill

metadata.description: Multi-level quality control checkpoint system for Apple platform development (iOS, macOS, iPadOS)

plugins.name: apple-overseer
plugins.description: Use this skill when you need to validate and quality-check Apple platform projects through multiple checkpoint levels. Like a multi-story building with floor managers, each level validates specific aspects (foundation, platform-specific requirements, integration, final QA) before giving approval to proceed. Perfect for ensuring iOS, macOS, and iPadOS projects meet quality standards at every stage of development.

usage.example: Run apple overseer validation on my iOS project at ./MyApp
input_types: Specific platform target (iOS, macOS, iPadOS, or all)
when_to_use: Before releasing an Apple platform application
When ensuring quality standards are met
After major refactoring or feature additions
when_not_to_use: For non-Apple platform projects (Android, Web, etc.)
When you just need to run unit tests
For simple script or tool projects

test_queries: Validate my iOS app using apple overseer
Run checkpoint validation on my macOS project
I need stamp of approval for my iPadOS app
Multi-level quality check for my Apple project
Run apple overseer on ./MyProject for all platforms
